subject: Apply a CRT monitor scanline effect: overlay horizontal scanlines at standard 480i phosphor pitch, add slight inter-scanline bloom and glow in bright areas, introduce a faint phosphor afterglow in very bright regions, apply mild barrel distortion at frame edges simulating a CRT curve, and apply a subtle shadow-mask phosphor dot pattern. Add a very faint green phosphor tint to the overall image. The result should feel like viewing through a high-quality broadcast CRT monitor from the late 1980s.
